Plugin.Name: Swap Manager
Plugin.Overview: Create and manage a swapfile from the Unraid WebUI: size, location, autostart, enable and disable. Works with swapfiles on xfs, ext4 and single-device btrfs pools or disks, and with a ZFS zvol. Swap follows the array lifecycle: it is enabled after the array start and disabled before the array stop, so a swapfile on a pool never blocks unmounting. Locations the mover would move are refused. Optional swap usage history graph on the settings page and the dashboard. Settings are under Settings - User Utilities - Swap Manager.
